courses.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Python
courses.description: A first course in AI for people with no programming background. Learners write Python from the first week and finish by building and explaining simple prediction models.
courses.target_audience: Students, career changers and professionals from non-technical fields who want to start in AI.
courses.entry_requirements: No programming experience required. Basic computer skills and secondary-school mathematics.
learning_outcomes: Write Python programs using variables, loops, functions and lists
Load and explore a small dataset with pandas
Explain what supervised learning is and when to use it
Train and evaluate a simple classification model with scikit-learn
topics: What AI and machine learning are
career_outcomes: Junior data or AI assistant roles
Foundation for the Machine Learning Practitioner course

courses.name: Machine Learning Practitioner
courses.description: Hands-on machine learning for learners who already code in Python. Covers the full workflow from data preparation to model selection, validation and communicating results.
courses.target_audience: Developers, analysts and graduates who know Python and want practical machine-learning skills.
courses.entry_requirements: Comfortable with Python and basic statistics. AI-101 or equivalent experience.
learning_outcomes: Prepare data with feature engineering and pipelines
Compare models with cross-validation
Tune hyperparameters and avoid overfitting
Present model results and limitations to non-technical stakeholders
courses.delivery_mode: Hybrid (online sessions plus monthly on-campus labs in Cairo)

courses.name: Building LLM Applications with RAG
courses.description: Design, build and evaluate applications on large language models: prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and safe deployment.
courses.target_audience: Software engineers and ML practitioners who want to build production LLM features.
courses.entry_requirements: Solid Python, experience calling web APIs, and basic machine-learning knowledge (AI-201 or equivalent).
learning_outcomes: Design prompts and structured outputs for reliable behaviour
Build a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with a vector database
Evaluate answer quality and grounding
Plan deployment, cost and safety controls

courses.name: Excel for Business Analysis

Use lookup, logical and summary formulas
Build pivot tables and pivot charts
Create a one-page business report

faqs.question: How do I register for a course?
faqs.answer: Choose a course and intake, complete the online registration form, and pay the fee or the first instalment. Your seat is confirmed after payment.

faqs.question: Can I pay the course fee in instalments?
faqs.answer: Yes for most courses. The number of instalments is listed for each course; the first payment is due before the course starts.

faqs.question: What is the refund policy?
faqs.answer: You can get a full refund up to 7 days before the start date, and a 50% refund until the end of the first week. No refunds after the first week.

faqs.question: Do I get a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Learners who attend at least 80% of sessions and pass the final project receive an Andalusia Academy certificate of completion. Courses are not officially accredited.

faqs.question: Are the courses accredited?
faqs.answer: No. Andalusia Academy certificates are certificates of completion. Some courses are designed with industry frameworks in mind, but they are not officially accredited.

faqs.question: How do online classes work?
faqs.answer: Online classes are live sessions on the academy's virtual classroom at fixed times. Recordings are available for 30 days after each session.

faqs.question: What if I miss a session?
faqs.answer: Online sessions are recorded. For on-campus sessions you can attend the same session in another group when seats are available.

faqs.question: Is there a placement test?
faqs.answer: Intermediate and advanced courses may require a short online placement test if you have not completed the listed prerequisite course.

faqs.question: What language are the courses taught in?
faqs.answer: Each course lists its language. Most are taught in Arabic and English; some advanced courses are taught in English.

faqs.question: Do I need my own laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes for online courses. On-campus courses provide lab computers, but a personal laptop is recommended for practice.

faqs.question: Can companies enrol their teams?
faqs.answer: Yes. Corporate groups of 8 or more can request a private class and a tailored schedule through the admissions office.

faqs.question: Do you help with jobs after the course?
faqs.answer: Learners get a portfolio review and CV workshop. The academy does not guarantee job placement.
